home.hero_description: Expert repair and maintenance for computers, laptops, and all gaming consoles. Fast turnaround, genuine parts, and warranty on every fix.
home.review1_text: My PS5 had the infamous disc drive error. Brought it in and they had it sorted within the same day. Incredibly fast and the staff actually knew what they were talking about!
home.review2_text: Got my gaming laptop screen replaced here after a nasty drop. The screen looks perfect — you'd never know it was replaced. Pricing was fair and they finished ahead of schedule.
home.review3_text: They built my entire gaming PC from scratch. The cable management is immaculate and they walked me through every part choice.
